details:
As it stands currently there are 2 immobile types for Physbones:

All Motion - Reduces motion calculated from root's parent

World - Reduces motion from world transforms but preserves from animation or IK

There are a few issues with the immobile settings, especially in regards to the World immobile type not factoring/calculating rotation from the main root of the avatar. For something like the World immobile I feel it would be better as a boolean with an optional Local Transform Override, this way when rotating in VRChat the physbones will not move around and will rely on the parent's transform/rotation values instead especially in regards to world fixed objects or child objects that need their own physbone transforms that are not directly rooted in the main armature.

I'm basing my request from a combination of these two posts:

1) https://vrchat.canny.io/avatar-dynamics-reports-and-feedback/p/feedback-allow-physbone-world-immobile-setting-to-reduce-rotational-movement

2) https://vrchat.canny.io/feature-requests/p/physbone-immobile-world-and-playspace-as-separate-settings
title: [Feedback] Add better root/parent transforms for immobile settings
